say:1:1033519001:1.text: I got permission from Master Dahnie to hang around the Lucent Tree for a bit and keep an eye on things.
say:1:1033519001:1.source_cn: 我向达赫妮贤者申请，暂时留守在流荧树下，观察一段时间。
say:1:1033519001:1.male: I got permission from Master Dahnie to hang around the Lucent Tree for a bit and keep an eye on things.
say:1:1033519001:1.female: I got permission from Master Dahnie to hang around the Lucent Tree for a bit and keep an eye on things.

say:2:1033519002:1.text: That tree's always been our sacred symbol. After this whole corruption mess, I've learned not to blindly trust others.
say:2:1033519002:1.source_cn: 流荧树一直是我们心中的神圣象征。这次腐化事件后，我发觉...
say:2:1033519002:1.male: That tree's always been our sacred symbol. After this whole corruption mess, I've learned not to blindly trust others.
say:2:1033519002:1.female: That tree's always been our sacred symbol. After this whole corruption mess, I've learned not to blindly trust others.

say:3:1033519003:1.text: Even if they're a fellow Wilder or some esteemed sage...
say:3:1033519003:1.source_cn: 即便那人同是绿裔成员，甚至是威严的贤者……
say:3:1033519003:1.male: Even if they're a fellow Wilder or some esteemed sage...
say:3:1033519003:1.female: Even if they're a fellow Wilder or some esteemed sage...
